title: Apartment 45, Broadmeadow Castle, Ashbourne, Co. Meath
seoTitle: Apartment 45, Broadmeadow Castle, Ashbourne, Co. Meath
description:
**Email Enquiries Only**

Doran Estates are delighted to present Apartment No. 45, a well-appointed two-bedroom first-floor apartment situated within the popular and secure gated Broadmeadow Castle development in the heart of Ashbourne.

The accommodation is bright and well laid out, comprising an entrance hall with useful storage, a spacious living/dining area, a separate kitchen, two generously sized bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, and a main bathroom. The property offers comfortable and practical accommodation in a well-established residential development.

The location is a particular highlight, with Ashbourne Town Centre just a short walk away. Residents can enjoy easy access to a wide range of local amenities, including shops, cafés, restaurants, bars, schools, crèches, gyms, parks and sporting facilities.
The apartment is also exceptionally well connected by public transport. Ashbourne Connect and Bus Éireann stops are approximately a two-minute walk away, providing convenient links to Dublin City Centre and Dublin Airport. The N2 and M50 are also easily accessible by car, making commuting and travel throughout Dublin and the surrounding areas straightforward.
With its excellent location, generous accommodation and convenient transport connections, Apartment No. 45 represents an excellent rental opportunity in the heart of Ashbourne.

Early viewing is highly recommended to appreciate everything this property has to offer.
